scope: PR001 controller; broad roadmap/device qualification stays separate

cases.title: Whole pinned tree with more than two pages
cases.setup_and_action: Use included 45-file Git fixture; start once and pump sequentially.
cases.expected: 3 page commits at default 20, tail file accounted, pending=0, cursor=total=45, one run/snapshot, exact_for_indexed=true; captured binary is not labelled AI-read.

cases.title: Idempotent START and STEP replay
cases.setup_and_action: Double START using one intentKey; lose a STEP response after commit, replay the exact expectedCursor.
cases.expected: Same run_id/snapshot; replay does not process another page or duplicate chunks; current cursor returned. A second active intent yields ACTIVE_SCAN_EXISTS.

cases.title: Crash before and after commit
cases.setup_and_action: Inject failure after chunk insertion but before transaction commit; separately simulate response loss after commit.
cases.expected: First case rolls back entries/chunks/cursor consistently; second resumes from committed cursor after STATUS. No skipped/duplicated source ranges.
cases.evidence_required: Fault injection plus new native process reopening store

cases.title: Pause/restart/Continue
cases.setup_and_action: Pause after a page; close UI; reopen a fresh client and STATUS; explicitly Continue.
cases.expected: Same run/snapshot/cursor and PAUSED state; zero automatic STEP on reopen; explicit Continue reaches tail. Reopen a RUNNING run too: explicit Continue uses reconciled current revision; reconnect itself makes no STEP.
cases.evidence_required: Fresh-client state restoration + real backend receipt

cases.title: Cancel and late reply
cases.setup_and_action: Cancel with a STEP in flight; allow an already-started page to finish; deliver a delayed old UI reply; reopen and replay START with original key.
cases.expected: No next STEP after pause/cancel intent; committed CANCELLED persists, old intent remains terminal, late reply never revives pump. New explicit intent is distinct.
cases.evidence_required: Backend control history plus deferred UI response fixture

cases.title: Changed HEAD and profile
cases.setup_and_action: Change commit between pages; separately revoke/change operator profile or selected alias.
cases.expected: SOURCE_DRIFT/BLOCKED or typed scope failure; no mixed HEAD bytes, old snapshot preserved; wrong namespace/profile cannot inspect or step the run.
cases.evidence_required: Two real Git commits and profile/scope negative cases

cases.title: Legacy and existing database compatibility
cases.setup_and_action: Create old-style DB/snapshot/review records with legacy endpoints, upgrade additive control schema, reopen again.
cases.expected: Old records and legacy scan/get/export still readable; migration idempotent; state table not a second store; downgrade limitations recorded.
cases.evidence_required: Old-schema data comparison and legacy endpoint results

cases.title: Typed native endpoint roundtrip
cases.setup_and_action: Run UI→NativeClient→JobHost→DurableBridge→installed Python adapter→SQLite; test hello negotiation/invalid fields.
cases.expected: New command advertised only when available; exact fields; UI cannot supply root/argv/store; envelopes stay inside actual native limits; older host gives explicit unavailable.

cases.title: Controls, counters and responsiveness
cases.setup_and_action: Hold a STEP promise; use keyboard-accessible Pause/Stop; return initial ledger with all entries PENDING and switch selected repo/client.
cases.expected: Controls remain enabled while scanning; processed initially 0, not accounted=total; no parallel requests; stale responses ignored; event-loop yields between pages.
cases.evidence_required: UI controller/DOM integration with counters and control assertions; Windows device status separate

cases.title: Empty and already completed snapshot
cases.setup_and_action: Start on an empty Git tree and on an already COMPLETE saved snapshot.
cases.expected: Terminal COMPLETE without endless STEP; totals and raw proof valid; no duplicate source insertion. Preserve existing snapshot completion/head publication semantics for empty trees.

cases.title: Explicit limits and metadata gaps
cases.setup_and_action: Force existing Git output limit; force oversized blob; inspect existing link/submodule/exclusion metadata and captured non-UTF8 fixture.
cases.expected: No silent truncation or cap-removal; limit failure blocks completion appropriately; processed dispositions persist; COMPLETE inventory with gaps never becomes all bytes/AI-read claim.
cases.evidence_required: Limit fault fixture and entry-outcome report

cases.title: No-progress/timeout reconciliation
cases.setup_and_action: Native STEP times out or repeatedly returns unchanged cursor; lose PAUSE/CANCEL reply; deliver late CONTINUE with stale revision.
cases.expected: Stop pump and show explicit blocker; STATUS reconciles unknown commit/control outcome; no tight retry loop or stale unpause; cursor/revision checks are atomic.
